column1: # scripts/capabilities.tsv — the single source of truth for every capability
# bootstrap.sh can wire into a child repo (spec 033).
# One catalog: --list renders it, the interactive menu renders it (grouped by
# the category column, in file order), --all iterates it, the flag parser
# matches its `flag` column, and --dry-run prints its `files`/`init_ci`
# columns. bootstrap.sh names no capability of its own — it only names the
# ACTION VERBS a row may reference (see the `action` column below).
# Format — pipe-separated, 10 fields, comments (`#`) and blank lines ignored:
#   id          stable, greppable identifier (also the outcome-line subject)
#   stack       required stack: backend | frontend | ci | none
#   flag        the non-interactive flag this capability answers to
#               ("--flag value" for value-taking flags, bare "--flag" otherwise)
#   baseline    yes = always selected (core wiring); no = opt-in
#                 pointer           real AGENTS.md pointer file, never a symlink
#                 copy-template     copy every files item (see syntax below)
#                 merge-tsconfig    merge strict flags into tsconfig*.json
#                 none              no local write; effect comes from init_ci
#                 information       listed only, never selected by --all
#   files       space-separated write plan. Item syntax:
#                 +DEST:SRC                 append SRC to DEST, guarded by a
#                 ...@STACK                 apply only when STACK is detected
#   init_ci     flags forwarded to init-ci.sh (aggregated into one invocation)
#   conflicts   comma-separated capability ids this one cannot be combined with
# The first row whose category is "CI platform" and whose init_ci carries
# --platform is the default platform when a selected capability needs a CI
# file but no platform was chosen.
# Not carried as a "files written" row because nothing is written for it: the
# okf reference (.standards/okf/) is consumed in place, and a root `okf`
# symlink is actively removed by the core-wiring run (same dangling-link
# hazard as AGENTS.md in submodule-less CI checkouts).
